# Nexus Academy

> Nexus Academy offers 1-on-1 online tutoring in math, science and English for students in grades 1 to 12. Every session is live, with one student and one tutor working together on an interactive online whiteboard. There are no group sessions.

## About

- A team of tutors, each with specializations in different fields, founded by Pranav Bhatia.
- Pranav holds a degree in Biomedical Sciences and Psychology from the University of Toronto Mississauga and has more than five years of experience teaching online and in person.
- The team works with students of every age, grade and learning style, including students with special needs.

## What sessions cover

- Test prep
- Homework help
- Extra practice
- Learning concepts
- Subjects: math, science and English, grades 1 to 12

## Pricing

- Demo session for new students: $15 for a full one-hour session.
- Weekly lessons: $20 to $25 per hour, depending on the student's grade level.
- Lessons are prepaid a week at a time.

## How it works

- At least one session a week is the minimum to register.
- Sessions happen at a fixed weekly time, the same day and time every week.
- Last-minute help is available outside the usual time, for example before a test.
- Older students can contact their tutor directly; parents still get regular updates.
- A session needs a computer or tablet with a steady internet connection.
